title: Replay history admission lacks focused regression coverage
reasoning: This module decides what multimodal/text content is persisted and replayed, including role-specific assistant text conversion, refusal retention, image admission only for non-assistant roles, scalar stringification, and assistant admission based on tool_calls or normalized text. The feature metadata includes no linked tests, so regressions here could silently drop replayable content, persist the wrong block shape, or admit/reject assistant messages incorrectly.
recommendation: Add focused unit tests that lock the intended normalization and admission contract for assistant, user, empty, refusal, image, scalar, and tool_call cases.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature declares no tests, and no included test file provides intended behavior evidence for these replay/persistence paths.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add tests under tests/backend for history_admission covering assistant text/input_text/output_text normalization to output_text, refusal preservation, non-assistant image_url/input_image preservation, assistant image omission, empty/unknown blocks returning None, mixed text concatenation, and should_store_assistant_history_message behavior with valid tool_calls versus blank content.
minimumFixScope: Add a focused backend unit test module for backend.src.agent.history.history_admission; no production code change is required unless tests reveal a contract mismatch.
